name: Anna Midaller's
source:
Anna Midaller's is a cafe known for its pies, especially cream pies. This place is crowded. Let's investigate its popularity.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
安娜·米达勒的咖啡馆因馅饼而闻名，尤其是奶油馅饼。这家店总是人潮拥挤。让我们调查它受欢迎的原因。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
